decisions.reason: Citrus crates are niche and seasonally concentrated, but organisational slack permits continued evaluation while its low website prominence suggests only moderate drop risk.
Foldable large containers have strong fit with reusable logistics trends and retained a dedicated webpage, signalling results above aspirations.
Stackable crates face commodity competition but leverage existing manufacturing scale and remain within the firm's core returnable packaging portfolio.
Rackable pallets serve steady industrial demand and align with existing capabilities, giving no clear shortfall signal.
Spill-retention pallets address regulatory and safety needs, and although website prominence declined, slack allows retention.
Load-retainer pallets are more specialised and were downgraded on the website, suggesting uncertain adoption, but slack justifies keeping for now.
